findings.explanation: A signed-in user who is not an admin can call the function "admin_delete_user", which runs with more rights than the caller.
findings.fix: Make "admin_delete_user" admin-only: run REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public."admin_delete_user" FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated; and call it only from your server, or check inside the function that the caller is an admin and raise an error if not.
